Books & Films.

What shapes how I think.

Films

The Social Network

Drama / Biography

The ruthless founding of Facebook. A masterclass in ambition, betrayal, and how a dorm-room idea became a billion-dollar empire.

Made in India: A Titan Story

Documentary

The chronicle of how Titan grew from a small watch company into one of India's most iconic brands. Innovation meets nation-building.

Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story

Drama / Thriller

The rise and fall of Harshad Mehta, the man who single-handedly exploited the Indian banking system and shook Dalal Street to its core.

Moneyball

Drama / Sports

How the Oakland A's used data and economics to outsmart every big-budget team in baseball. The original "numbers don't lie" story.
